title: The Guild Throne
note: All Onyx Atelier story text. Plain words. Rival play styles are extra AI weights (opponent.ai).

odile.name: Mistress Odile
odile.role: Your teacher. Kind, dry, and never wrong about a stone.

pip.name: Pip Larkin
pip.role: The other apprentice on your street. Eager, a little careless.

bastien.name: Bastien Coil
bastien.role: The Hoarder. Sits on gems and keeps jewels so you cannot have them.

saffi.name: Saffi Vane
saffi.role: The Rusher. Buys anything cheap, as fast as she can.

verena.name: Lady Verena
verena.role: The Patron Collector. Wins friends at court and takes your Favours.

corwin.name: Corwin Thale
corwin.role: The Crown Chaser. Wants crowns, and nothing else.

master.name: The Guild Master
master.role: Head of every atelier in the city. Plays every style at once.

acts.title: The Guild Hall
acts.blurb: The road to the guild's throne.

chapters.title: The First Bench

intro.text: Welcome to my atelier. A bench, a lamp, and a bag of gems. That is all a jeweller needs.
Take gems in a straight line, then buy a jewel. Pip will sit across from you today.

outro.text: Clean work. Pip is still sweeping up his spilled pearls.

chapters.lose: Pip got there first. Take gems in a line and buy the cheap jewels early.

opponent.name: Pip Larkin
opponent.personality: Friendly and careless. Takes whatever is shiny.
opponent.taunt: Ha! Beat you to it. Again?
opponent.praise: You are quick. I need more practice.

chapters.tip: Lesson 2: tap 1-3 gems in a line, then Take.

chapters.title: Cheaper by the Colour

intro.text: Every jewel you own makes the next one of its colour cheaper. That is your bonus.
Build one colour and watch the big pieces fall into your hands.

outro.text: See? The third Sapphire nearly paid for itself.

chapters.lose: Pick one colour and keep buying it. The bonus does the rest.

opponent.name: Pip Larkin
opponent.personality: Still eager. Now he copies what you buy.
opponent.praise: All right, all right. Bonuses matter.

stars.text: Get a bonus of 3 in one colour

chapters.tip: Lesson 4: each jewel you own is a bonus gem of its colour.

chapters.title: Gold in the Drawer

intro.text: Gold is the only wild gem. You get it by keeping a jewel for later.
A kept jewel is safe in your drawer. Keep one today, and buy it before the end.

outro.text: A jeweller who plans ahead never runs short. Good.

chapters.lose: Take a gold coin to keep a jewel, then save up and buy it.

opponent.name: Pip Larkin
opponent.personality: Has started to think. Watch the jewel you want.
opponent.taunt: I took the one you wanted, didn't I?

easier.text: Pip goes back to playing loosely

chapters.tip: Lesson 5: tap a gold coin, then a jewel, to keep it.

chapters.title: The Hoarder of Lantern Row

intro.text: Bastien Coil runs the shop at the end of the row. He hoards gems so nobody else can buy.
Your teacher sends a child? Fine. Everything on this board will end up in my drawer.
Watch the Favours. Each greedy grab of his hands you a free gem.

outro.text: Hmph. Keep the street, then. I keep my stones.
Lantern Row knows your name now.

chapters.lose: Bastien sits on gems. Buy cheap jewels so you need fewer of them.

opponent.name: Bastien Coil
opponent.personality: Holds lots of gems and keeps jewels you want.
opponent.taunt: Every stone you need is in my drawer.
opponent.praise: You found a way past my drawer. Well done.

twist.text: Bastien starts with 2 gems in his hand.

easier.text: Bastien plays one level gentler and starts with no gems

chapters.tip: Lesson 6: a Favour takes any one gem before your move.

chapters.title: The Market Arcade

intro.text: The arcade is loud and fast. Saffi Vane sells more rings than anyone.
Slow hands, empty shelves. Try to keep up.
Some jewels have powers. Encore gives you another turn. Use them.

outro.text: Fine. You are faster than you look.

chapters.lose: Saffi buys fast. Grab jewels with powers to get extra gems and turns.

opponent.name: Saffi Vane
opponent.personality: Buys the cheapest jewel every turn. Races for 20 points.
opponent.praise: You out-ran me. That never happens.

goal.text: Win the duel. You start with a Favour.

chapters.tip: Lesson 7: a jewel's power happens once, when you buy it.

chapters.title: A Word at Court

intro.text: Crowns on a jewel catch the eye of the court. At 3 crowns a patron joins you.
A patron is free points. Win one today.

outro.text: A patron's name opens doors. Lady Verena will have heard.

chapters.lose: Look for jewels with crowns. Three crowns brings a patron.

opponent.name: Saffi Vane
opponent.personality: Still rushing. She ignores the court.
opponent.praise: Huh. Maybe crowns are worth it.

chapters.tip: Lesson 7: at 3 crowns, choose a patron.

chapters.title: Open Hands

intro.text: A rematch, here in the open. No keeping jewels in drawers. Only what is on the table.
She wants a clean race. Buy straight from the table and stay ahead.

outro.text: No tricks, and you still won. I will tell the arcade.
Good. Now the court is watching.

chapters.lose: No keeping this time. Plan two buys ahead so you never need the drawer.

opponent.name: Saffi Vane
opponent.personality: Races for points. Never keeps a jewel.

chapters.title: The Lady's Salon

intro.text: So you are the apprentice everyone whispers about. Sit. Let us see your manners.
Verena collects patrons and Favours. She starts with two of them already.
Do not hand her more. Avoid big refills and greedy grabs.

outro.text: Charming. You may call on me again.
The court is yours. Next, the Guild Hall.

chapters.lose: Verena feeds on Favours. Take smaller handfuls and refill less.

opponent.name: Lady Verena
opponent.personality: Hoards Favours and chases patrons. Smiles while she steals.
opponent.taunt: Thank you for the Favours, dear.
opponent.praise: You kept your Favours and your nerve. Impressive.

goal.text: Win the duel against Lady Verena.

stars.text: End with a Favour in hand

easier.text: Verena plays one level gentler and starts with no Favours

chapters.title: The Guild Hall Steps

intro.text: Crowns, apprentice. Ten of them, and the hall bows. Nothing else matters.
Corwin got here first and he has a head start. Do not chase his crowns. Race your own way.

outro.text: Points? You beat me with points? Unthinkable.

chapters.lose: Corwin starts ahead. Buy cheap jewels early and catch up with bonuses.

opponent.name: Corwin Thale
opponent.personality: Chases crowns above all. Grabs every jewel with a crown.
opponent.praise: You never chased my crowns. Smart.

twist.text: Corwin starts with 3 gems in his hand.

easier.text: Corwin plays loosely, head start stays

chapters.title: The Short Commission

intro.text: A buyer from the palace wants a finished piece by nightfall. Work fast.
I am back, and I am bidding too. My drawer is full again.

outro.text: Delivered before the bells. The palace will remember.

chapters.lose: Win within 20 turns. Buy jewels with points and skip slow plans.

opponent.name: Bastien Coil
opponent.personality: Hoards gems and keeps jewels. Harder than before.
opponent.taunt: Too slow. The palace buys from me.
opponent.praise: Fast and sharp. I underrated you.

chapters.title: Ten Crowns

intro.text: A rematch, on my terms. Crowns only. Win with ten crowns, or do not win at all.
Then beat him at his own game. Every crown you take is one he cannot.

outro.text: Ten crowns, on your head. I yield.
Only one door is left. The Guild Master's.

chapters.lose: Count crowns. Patrons help you reach ten faster.

opponent.name: Corwin Thale
opponent.personality: Chases crowns, now at full strength.
opponent.taunt: The crowns are mine. They always were.
opponent.praise: You out-crowned the crown chaser. Remarkable.

chapters.title: The Guild Throne

intro.text: Every atelier in this city answers to me. You want my chair? Earn it.
The Master hoards, rushes and chases crowns, all at once. And already owns a Ring.
Everything I taught you, use it now. I will be watching from the gallery.

outro.text: The chair is yours. Guard it better than I did.
Can I be your apprentice now?

chapters.lose: The Master starts ahead. Build bonuses early and guard your Favours.

opponent.name: The Guild Master
opponent.personality: Plays every style at once. Starts with a Ring and a Favour.
opponent.taunt: Sit down, apprentice. The chair is not for you.
opponent.praise: Well played. The guild is yours.

twist.text: The Guild Master starts with one Ring already bought.

easier.text: The Master plays one level gentler and starts with no Ring
